purpose: Delivers email and SMS messages for the payment platform.

components.name: domain-events
components.evidence: Carries the events that trigger messages.

components.name: notifier
components.evidence: Reads the events, selects a template and channel, renders the message, calls the provider and records the status.

components.name: Email and SMS provider
components.evidence: External service that delivers the messages.

flows.evidence: The notifier passes the rendered message to the provider for delivery.
